pink._emit: The engine must NOT emit every axis every turn. Fourteen axes rendered in full is the same body report in a new costume. Pick the axes with the largest travel, plus a rotating couple, capped at six per transformation — the books dwell on four to six things and leave the rest implied.

height._note: Male bands are 2" wide across the library's real 4'8"-6'9" spread. Female landings were 3 bands and are now 5 — the engine rolls an exact height and a 3-band landing meant one cell spanned a 4" range, so "six inches leaving" fired on a four-inch drop. NO CELL MAY NAME A NUMBER OF INCHES OR A SPECIFIC HEIGHT: the roll knows the real figure and it rides in the tag attribute. Fragments carry the feel of the move, never its measurement. A cell may use the token {inches}: the engine computes the real difference between the card's height and the rolled one and substitutes it as words ("an inch", "six inches"). That is the ONLY way a figure may appear — Cody 2026-09-13: "must be able to compute the hight loss/gain and plug that number in". Cells whose move is under two inches carry no such phrasing.
